"""A fixed sample file for the parsing golden test (E07-01)."""


def greet(name: str) -> str:
    # a comment, so the golden file pins comment node types too
    return f"hello {name}"


class Greeter:
    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.name = name

    def greet(self) -> str:
        return greet(self.name)
